papers.authors: Jiale Wang, Chen Zhao, Haoyang Zhang, Yanhao Wu, Fei He, Yanhu Shan, Rui Wu, Wei Ke, Tong Zhang
papers.evidence: 结合几何先验的三维高斯泼溅场景表示与渲染
papers.tldr: 前馈高斯泼溅的像素对齐预测会使基元数量随图像分辨率和视角数增长，带来冗余与计算开销；非像素对齐方法虽固定基元数，却缺少射线与深度约束，易出现中心错位和大视角渲染伪影。GeoGSplat将几何先验显式引入非像素对齐框架，用双分支编码器构建Anchors与Triplane，并通过分层解码器逐步解码稠密3D点与高斯基元。在DTU和NRGBD上，其新视角合成与重建均优于现有像素对齐和非像素对齐方法，且目标视角远离输入相机时优势更明显。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian Splatting enables efficient novel view synthesis, but pixel-aligned prediction makes the primitive count grow with image resolution and view count, leading to substantial redundancy and increased computational cost. Non-pixel-aligned methods address this limitation by predicting a fixed number of Gaussians. Without explicit ray and depth constraints, these methods yield misplaced Gaussian centers, causing rendering artifacts under large viewpoint changes. To address this issue, we introduce GeoGSplat, a geometry-grounded feed-forward model that explicitly incorporates geometric priors into the non-pixel-aligned framework. A dual-branch encoder constructs Anchors and Triplane to capture coarse 3D structure and fine-grained scene features, respectively. Subsequently, a hierarchical decoder progressively decodes dense 3D points and Gaussian primitives, enabling 3D reconstruction and novel view synthesis. GeoGSplat surpasses both state-of-the-art pixel-aligned and non-pixel-aligned Gaussian Splatting methods on DTU and NRGBD in terms of novel view synthesis and reconstruction. The advantage of our geometry-grounded paradigm further increases as target viewpoints move farther from the input cameras, demonstrating stronger generalization to large viewpoint changes. Project Page: https://comedy0913.github.io/projects/geogsplat

papers.title_en: GroundControl: Satellite-Conditioned Multi-View Diffusion for Reconstruction-Free Novel View Synthesis
papers.authors: Akshay Krishnan, Matias Turkulainen, Jamie Wynn, Zawar Qureshi, Mohamed Sayed, Guillermo Garcia-Hernando, Sara Vicente, James Hays, Michael Firman, Daniyar Turmukhambetov
papers.evidence: 卫星与街景互补条件用于神经新视角合成
papers.tldr: 稀疏街景新视角合成中，多视图扩散在外推时易产生不合理空间布局。GroundControl以卫星图像作为额外条件，通过交叉注意力将卫星布局与街景输入结合到预训练多视图扩散模型中，无需三维重建。户外实验表明其在新视角合成上优于卫星条件或街景条件基线，尤其源目标视图重叠很小时。该方法为无重建、布局可控的户外新视角生成提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Multi-view or video diffusion models have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for novel-view synthesis from sparse image collections. While they can produce high quality images, they tend to hallucinate unrealistic spatial layouts when synthesizing views outside the input views (scene extrapolation). We propose to address this challenge for outdoor scenes by using satellite images as an additional information source to condition the multi-view generative model. We introduce a new satellite-conditioned multi-view diffusion model that combines conditioning from a satellite image and street-level input images when generating novel-views. Our cross-attention based conditioning allows us to retain pretrained multi-view diffusion priors to generate seamless, realistic, novel views from a handful of source views, while also adhering to the scene layout as seen from satellite images. Our model does not use 3D scene reconstruction, and only relies on posed street and satellite views. Our experiments on outdoor datasets show that our model is better than both satellite-conditioned or street-view conditioned baselines on novel-view synthesis, especially on challenging cases where target views have very little overlap with source views. Project page: https://nianticspatial.github.io/groundcontrol

papers.title_en: Birth-Death Structural Learning for 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Quan Tran Hong, Long Nguyen-Chi, Binh T. Nguyen
papers.evidence: 面向3D高斯泼溅场景表示与渲染的原理化密度控制
papers.tldr: 3DGS的密度控制依赖位置梯度、不透明度等代理信号，难以直接回答应在何处增删高斯以降低多视图重建损失。论文提出基于重构损失一阶变分的生死控制，为每个高斯基元引入辅助质量坐标并对多视图损失求导，得到结构更新的局部下降替代分数。高分数高斯作为出生点，低分数且低不透明度高斯被删除，并集成到3DGS-MCMC中。标准基准上取得更优重建质量，在紧高斯预算下增益最显著，表明变分梯度指标可替代启发式代理。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a standard representation for real-time novel-view synthesis. Yet, its quality-efficiency trade-off still relies heavily on adaptive density control. Existing cloning, splitting, and pruning rules use proxy signals, such as position gradients, opacity, and image-space error. Although effective in practice, these signals do not directly answer the structural question behind density control: where should new Gaussians be allocated to reduce the multi-view reconstruction loss, and which existing primitives can be pruned with minimal penalty. To address this, we propose first-variation birth-death control for 3DGS, a principled approach that replaces heuristic structural decisions with a variational score derived from the reconstruction loss. At each structural update, we freeze the current Gaussian population, attach auxiliary mass coordinates to each primitive, and differentiate the multiview loss with respect to these coordinates. We demonstrate that this score is a coordinate of the first variation of the Splat Regression Model, giving a rigorous local descent surrogate for birth-death moves: high-score Gaussians are selected as birth sites, while low-score, low-opacity Gaussians are selected for removal. Across standard 3DGS benchmarks, integrating this score into 3DGS-MCMC yields state-of-the-art reconstruction quality and outperforms existing methods, delivering the most significant gains under tight Gaussian budgets. Ultimately, our work provides compelling evidence that gradient-based variational metrics offer a principled alternative to proxy heuristics in 3DGS.

papers.title_en: Foundation4D: Towards a unified perception and reconstruction model for autonomous vehicles
papers.authors: NVIDIA, :, Sérgio Agostinho, Maximilian Apodaca, Emmanuel Attia, Guillem Braso, George Dong, Ilya Fedorov, Michele Fenzi, Gang Huang, Jiahui Huang, Shengyu Huang, Bingxin Ke, Laura Leal-Taixé, Kuan-Ting Lee, Mingxuan Liu, Tian Liu, Tim Meinhardt, Aljoša Ošep, Naveen Kumar Rai, Kefei Ren, Cristiano Saltori, Keqiang Wu, Ning Xu, Fei Xue, Jin-Bey Yu, Lei Zhang, Qunjie Zhou
papers.evidence: 跨视角与时间的多相机多视图高斯重建
papers.tldr: 自动驾驶多相机视频的几何、检测、占用与重建常被分开建模，缺少统一前馈方案。Foundation4D 以共享骨干和分解式时空注意力融合跨相机、跨时间观测，统一完成几何估计、3D 检测、语义占用与高斯重建，并用位姿图优化和目标跟踪组装视频结果。在 Waymo、nuScenes 和 OpenOccupancy 上取得领先深度、检测与占用指标，联合训练还同时提升检测与几何，并可作为无激光雷达 NuRec 的先验。
papers.abstract_en: We introduce Foundation4D, a unified feed-forward model for geometry estimation, 3D detection, semantic occupancy, and Gaussian reconstruction from multi-camera driving video. A shared backbone uses factorized spatiotemporal attention to efficiently combine observations across cameras and time. Our video inference pipeline uses pose graph optimization to refine camera trajectories and assembles object tracks across input windows. We also develop a data annotation pipeline and release PAI-Foundation4D, a benchmark with dense depth and semantic occupancy labels for 1,253 driving clips. With benchmark-specific fine-tuning, Foundation4D achieves the lowest depth AbsRel on Waymo and nuScenes, the highest detection mAP on nuScenes, and the highest occupancy mIoU on OpenOccupancy among the compared methods. Our task-combination study shows benefits for both detection and geometry: co-training detection with geometry and occupancy improves top-class mAP by 1.2 points over detection-only training, while co-training geometry with detection reduces camera-to-rig translation error by $13.4\%$ relative to geometry-only training. We further use the predicted geometry and trajectories as priors for lidarless NuRec, supporting reconstruction of driving scenes for simulation.

papers.title_en: RelateGS: Reliable Semantic and Relational Evidence for 3D Scene Understanding with Gaussian Splatting
papers.evidence: 语言感知三维高斯泼溅场景表示与多视图语义聚合
papers.tldr: 语言感知的3DGS已用于3D场景理解，但关系感知定位不仅取决于语义与关系信息的表示，还取决于场景侧证据是否可靠、充分；多视角聚合会引入弱观测，关系在给定相机轨迹下也可能观测不足。RelateGS构建结构化语言感知高斯表示，在语义提升时抑制不可靠观测，并将多视角物体观测整合为持久3D图，由图识别欠观测关系并定向重查询已有帧补全证据。在Sr3D+和Nr3D上Acc@0.25分别较此前最优提升7.9和1.7个百分点。
papers.abstract_en: Language-aware 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has advanced language-driven 3D scene understanding by incorporating semantic and relational cues into reconstructed scenes. However, relation-aware grounding depends not only on representing such information, but also on whether the underlying scene-side evidence is reliable and sufficient. Multi-view semantic aggregation can incorporate weak observations, while object relations can remain under-observed along the available camera trajectory, leading to ambiguous evidence for target disambiguation. We present RelateGS, a structured language-aware Gaussian representation that selectively refines semantic and relational evidence for 3D visual grounding. RelateGS suppresses unreliable observations during semantic feature uplifting and consolidates multi-view object observations into a persistent 3D graph. The graph further identifies under-observed object relations and guides targeted re-querying of informative existing frames to complement their evidence. Experiments on Sr3D+ and Nr3D demonstrate competitive 3D grounding performance, improving the previous best by 7.9 and 1.7 percentage points at Acc@0.25, respectively.

papers.title_en: DUET4D: Self-Corrective Coupled Guidance for Sparse-View 4D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Beizhen Zhao, Nanjie Yao, Boyi Fu, Qingsong Yan, Haofan Ren, Kaiyong Zhao, Hao Wang
papers.evidence: 面向稀疏视角4D高斯泼溅优化的自校正耦合引导
papers.tldr: 稀疏视角4D重建高度欠约束，生成先验可补外观，但视频模型迭代成本高、单视图模型时序不一致，直接吸收生成输出还会产生冗余基元与漂浮伪影。DUET4D提出自校正耦合引导框架，利用当前高斯证据构建序列对齐以引导潜空间恢复，并用Sequential Fidelity Resampling将生成监督提升到高斯空间筛选可靠基元。校正表示再为下一轮恢复提供更可靠证据，形成闭环。实验表明其显著提升渲染质量与效率，为稀疏视角4D重建提供高效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Sparse-view 4D reconstruction is highly under-constrained when only a few cameras are available. Generative priors can recover missing appearances, but video models are computationally impractical for iterative reconstruction, whereas single-view models produce temporally inconsistent pseudo-observations. Moreover, directly absorbing uncertain generative outputs into Gaussian optimization often creates redundant primitives and floating artifacts. To address these challenges, we propose DUET4D, a self-corrective coupled guidance framework for sparse-view 4D Gaussian splatting. The core of our approach is a self-corrective framework where the 4D representation guides generative prior for spatio-temporal consistent supervisions. We first construct sequential alignments from current Gaussian evidence to steer the latent restoration. Then we use Sequential Fidelity Resampling to lift generative supervisions into Gaussian space to selectively distinguish repeatedly supported primitives. The corrected representation then provides more reliable Gaussian evidence for the next restoration cycle. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DUET4D significantly improves rendering quality and rendering efficiency.

papers.title_en: SG-Splat: Stable Geometry Learning under Pose Uncertainty for Pose-Free 3D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Xiaohan Lu, Jiaqi Zhang, Weijia Jiang, Siwei Ma
papers.evidence: 对位姿不确定性鲁棒的无位姿前馈3D高斯重建
papers.tldr: 无位姿前馈3DGS对残余位姿误差敏感，误差会扰动规范空间的高斯变换，给几何与属性学习带来噪声监督。SG-Splat将几何估计与高斯属性预测解耦为两条专用分支，并以Flow-Guided Pose Refinement和Residual-Guided Geometry Correction构成由粗到细的精化流程，再用混合真值与预测位姿的双路策略稳定训练。在DL3DV与RealEstate10K上，新视角合成与位姿估计均取得SOTA。该工作显著提升了位姿不确定性下的几何稳定性。
papers.abstract_en: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has become a promising representation for real-time novel view synthesis and 3D scene reconstruction. For practical deployment, recent studies have explored pose-free feed-forward 3DGS, which reconstructs Gaussian representations directly from unposed input images. However, these methods remain sensitive to residual pose errors, which perturb canonical-space Gaussian transformation, introducing noisy supervision for geometry and attribute learning. To address this problem, we present SG-Splat, a pose-free feed-forward 3DGS framework that improves robustness to pose uncertainty and stabilizes the learning of Gaussian primitives. SG-Splat decouples geometry estimation and Gaussian attribute prediction into two dedicated branches, reducing error coupling between pose-sensitive geometry and Gaussian attributes. We further introduce a coarse-to-fine refinement pipeline, consisting of Flow-Guided Pose Refinement (FGPR) and Residual-Guided Geometry Correction (RGC), to improve geometric alignment before Gaussian attribute reconstruction. Specifically, FGPR refines camera poses with flow-based correlation features and differentiable bundle adjustment. RGC then corrects initial point maps using depth residuals derived from FGPR, producing more reliable Gaussian centers. To stabilize training, we introduce a dual-path strategy that mixes ground-truth and predicted poses for canonical transformation. It provides clean supervision for Gaussian attributes while improving geometry robustness to residual pose errors. Extensive experiments on DL3DV and RealEstate10K show that SG-Splat achieves state-of-the-art performance in both novel view synthesis and pose estimation.
